crossing.rule: P2I-2AC's region re-read (never refiltered): for each surviving unit, the L1 runs of both cases at its arrival delivery and debt level, tau_D and g; a critical minute below the arrival D is a minute whose end deficit is > 0 with D below its arrival value and no minute before it that started and ended without deficit. Counted with P2I-2AC's D (repayment from the start deficit alone) and with P2I-2AD's D; a candidate is affected when either case has two or more such minutes.

demand.rule: Each candidate is filtered at demand x 0.9, x 1.0 and x 1.1 (the case's metabolic_demand_baseline scaled; demand reaches only the deficit, checked on full core runs). ROBUST_ACROSS_DEMAND: survives at all three; DEMAND_SENSITIVE: at one or two; DEMAND_INCOMPATIBLE: at none. Reported, never a filter: the final region is the one at 1.0, whatever its robustness.

efficiency.analytic_rule: no exact impossibility is known before simulation: every constraint reads the candidate's own simulated deficit path, so ANALYTIC_REJECTION stays 0

faculty.debt_repayment: D repays only during an interval that stays oxygen-adequate: effective deficit 0 at the start and at the end of the step; crossing 0 -> critical, no repayment and no debt added beyond what the deficit signal adds
faculty.demand: 0.9 / 1.0 / 1.1 explicit uncertainty: ROBUST_ACROSS_DEMAND, DEMAND_SENSITIVE, DEMAND_INCOMPATIBLE; no value approved; robustness never a hard filter
faculty.fd_lac: FD-LAC-01..06 unchanged (envelopes 57m 4.4-7.0 / 72f 3.4-5.5 at 60 untreated; FD-LAC-04 L(T*+30) < L(T*), no fixed 10 %; FD-LAC-05 57m 1.5-4.0 / 72f 1.2-3.5 with L120 < L(T*); FD-LAC-06 by actual flow and recovering-vs-persistent critical semantics)
faculty.hr_rr: CAUSAL_PROPAGATION_ACCEPTED; MAGNITUDE_PENDING_HR_RR_CALIBRATION: the corrected D raises HR and RR in untreated runs; D is not reverted; the historical P2F HR1 rejection is not a target; HR and RR are not calibrated here
faculty.l3_adequacy: L3 adequacy persists through 120: once sustained adequate or compensated oxygen availability begins after haemostasis, effective_deficit stays 0 through minute 120; otherwise L3_RESUSCITATION_LOST, rejected from the final L3 region, never an FD-LAC-05 failure; NOT_EVALUABLE is never a passing final L3 state
faculty.lactate_coupling: tau_D is debt-repayment kinetics only and must not define D -> lactate production; an independent D_to_lactate_gain, not derived from tau_D or tau_L, not tuned to the legacy, no value chosen
faculty.rho: physiological 2.0-3.0, 2.5 representative; 1 only synthetic reference; not in the physiological multiplicity; invariance under re-anchoring reported once

arrival_oxygen_debt.structural: only k x D0 reaches lactate

debt_per_delivery_deficit.structural: only k x g and k x D0 reach lactate

debt_to_lactate_gain.structural: only k x g and k x D0 reach lactate

arrival_oxygen_debt.acts: start value of D; repaid like any D

debt_clearance_tau_min.acts: only across minutes with no deficit at start and end
debt_clearance_tau_min.reaches_lactate: through D's repayment only; never production

debt_per_delivery_deficit.acts: while the deficit at the start of a minute is > 0

debt_to_lactate_gain.acts: every minute, on the D of the minute before
debt_to_lactate_gain.reaches_lactate: only as k x g and k x arrival D

rho.status: NON_IDENTIFIABLE (invariant): rho cancels in deficit, D, lactate and adequacy because the arrival ratio is re-anchored as ratio / rho; evaluated at 2.5 (representative of the 2.0-3.0 band), checked at 2.0 and 3.0, 1 only as SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE; never counted in the candidate multiplicity

identifiability.rule: On the final region (demand 1.0), per dimension, against the values present in the source space, as P2I-2AB: one value explored = NOT_VARIED; one left = WELL_CONSTRAINED; some excluded = PARTIALLY_CONSTRAINED; none excluded = POORLY_IDENTIFIED; structural = NON_IDENTIFIABLE_SEPARATELY (G and g reach lactate only as G x g with G x arrival debt). rho is not a dimension of the candidates (RHO_STATUS). Demand is read on the union of the three filters (the factors at which a candidate survives). Each status is set beside P2I-2AB's: NARROWER when fewer values survive, SAME, WIDER when more. No value is chosen by frequency. P2I-2AD: lactate reads (g, k, D0) only as k x g and k x D0 (D is linear in D0 and g given the deficit path and tau_D), so g, k and the arrival debt level are NON_IDENTIFIABLE_SEPARATELY; the products are reported as their own dimensions. Set beside P2I-2AC on the dimensions both have.

k_ld.old_reason: G (lactate_per_output_deficit, 2 / 6 / 12) was read as the steady-state lactate excess per unit of g x sustained deficit of the pre-P2I-2AC D (D* = g s tau_D, X* = k D* tau_L = G g s), with k = G / (tau_D tau_L). Since P2I-2AC D has no steady state under a deficit, and one G maps to nine production constants across the tau_D x tau_L grid: the G range carries tau_D in its units and cannot be translated into a gain independent of tau_D. The production constants the old grid induced are reported for comparison only.
k_ld.units: mmol/L per minute per unit of D (index-minutes)

legacy_reference.rule: LEGACY REFERENCE, NOT A CALIBRATION TARGET: the family engine's own lactate at 0, 15, 30, 60, 90 and 120 min, read after the filter and the representatives, never by a constraint or an ordering.

arrival_oxygen_debt.acts: start value of D; repaid like any D

debt_clearance_tau_min.acts: only across minutes with no deficit at start and end
debt_clearance_tau_min.reaches_lactate: through D's repayment only; never production

debt_per_delivery_deficit.acts: while the deficit at the start of a minute is > 0

debt_to_lactate_gain.acts: every minute, on the D of the minute before
debt_to_lactate_gain.reaches_lactate: only as k x g and k x arrival D

policy: Shadow only. The P2I-2AB current source space (its committed record), never the P2F historical region (P2FGuard). D repays only across oxygen-adequate minutes; lactate production is the independent D-to-lactate gain, explored on a range built before any count from dimensional consistency, the faculty envelopes and synthetic probes; FD-LAC-01..06 unchanged; L3 adequacy must persist through 120. Demand 0.9 / 1.1 is reported uncertainty, 1.0 the region; rho is not counted. Haemodynamics simulated once, D and lactate post-processed exactly (validated, else stop). HR and RR changes are a causal propagation, their magnitudes unapproved and uncalibrated here. The legacy lactate is read after the filter only. Nothing is fitted, selected or approved; collapse stays off.

region.status: FACULTY-CONSTRAINED CURRENT-PHYSIOLOGY LACTATE REGION (no value selected or approved)

fd04_sensitivity.note: diagnostic only: survivors that would also pass FD-LAC-04 with the fall required at the threshold; never filters

validation.rule: P2I-2AC's sample rule on this lactate side (per rate the first, middle and last P3 set; lactate-side indices 0, n/4, n/2, 3n/4, n-1 and the canonical point; L1, L3 and L2 at the first and last crystalloid point; both cases) at reserve 2.5, demand 1.0 and intrinsic midpoint: exact equality of every minute's lactate, D, deficit and actual flow, of haemostasis and stop, and of every verdict (FD-LAC, L3 adequacy, active and residual FD-LAC-06). On the canonical point also demand 0.9 and 1.1 and intrinsic lower / upper (exact), and reserve 2.0, 3.0 and the synthetic reference 1 (within 1e-9, identical verdicts). Any disagreement stops the run.

verdict.next_domain: Recommended next domain (not started; needs its own authorization): heart rate and the sympathetic response, whose magnitudes the corrected D already moves (MAGNITUDE_PENDING_HR_RR_CALIBRATION); then pressure and vascular tone, unless that analysis finds a more fundamental blocker. Before collapse, GI migration or any runtime integration.
verdict.rule: LACTATE_PHYSIOLOGY_READY_FOR_HR_DOMAIN when every check holds: (1) D temporal semantics coherent: the factorization validation finds D falling only across deficit-free minutes, no representative run has a D fall outside them or a critical minute below its arrival D, and in P2I-2AC's region no candidate keeps two or more critical minutes below its arrival D; (2) D -> lactate production no longer tied to tau_D (coupling_check); (3) the factorization agrees with the full core; (4) at least one candidate survives at demand 1.0 and every survivor is L3_RESUSCITATION_ADEQUATE_THROUGH_120 in both cases; (5) FD-LAC-04 is PASS or ALREADY_NORMALIZED and FD-LAC-05 PASS in both cases for every survivor (no NOT_EVALUABLE); (6) the demand layer classified every candidate; (7) the representatives are patient-like: no WORSENING_CRITICAL_WITH_LARGE_LACTATE_FALL, INSTANT_NORMALIZATION or INCOMPATIBLE_WITH_SURVIVAL flag and every rerun equals its factorized reading; (8) no unresolved lactate semantic contradiction: every survivor's FD-LAC-04 T* is its L3 adequacy onset in both cases. Otherwise LACTATE_PHYSIOLOGY_NOT_READY with the first blocker. Unique identification of hidden parameters is not required. No candidate, value or parameter is selected or approved.
